newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Handelsbanken rules out S-E-B merger.
newsitem.headline: Handelsbanken rules out S-E-B merger.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Handelsbanken said on Tuesday the question of a merger between it and S-E-Banken was not on the agenda as far as it was concerned.

"Against the background of the speculation which has arisen regarding a merger between S-E-Banken and Handelsbanken, the board has decided at its ordinary meeting today to make the statement that the question is not on the agenda for Handelsbanken's part," the bank said in a statement.

Recent reports in Swedish business daily Dagens Industri and elsewhere suggested that the two banks had entered into preliminary discussions at board level regarding the benefits of a possible merger.
Shares in the two banks rose sharply on the reports, but analysts said the difficulties encountered in merging the two corporate cultures would outweigh the benefits.
